subject.title: [Bug]: Subagent handoff stalls after delivered child result

question: Which durable owner should guarantee requester continuation when a direct child has already settled: the `sessions_yield` lifecycle or the child-task registry/reconciliation path?
rationale: The report rules out child execution and delivery failure, but the current dispatch helper only chooses delivery attempts; choosing the durable continuation owner defines retry, deduplication, and stale-turn semantics across the runtime.

options.title: Registry-owned reconciliation
options.body: Have the canonical child-task registry re-evaluate settled direct children for the active requester turn and enqueue one idempotent continuation.

options.title: Yield-lifecycle reconciliation
options.body: Make `sessions_yield` durably scan and consume already-settled direct children when a requester enters or resumes its yield state.

recommendation.title: Registry-owned reconciliation
recommendation.body: Have the canonical child-task registry re-evaluate settled direct children for the active requester turn and enqueue one idempotent continuation.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent work maintains the dispatch failure path that will need to interoperate with the selected continuation boundary.
